project_name: AI Incident Analyzer - Enterprise Banking IT Command Center

theme_strategy.vibe: Tactical Enterprise Command Center - Precision, High Density, APCA Compliant

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
typography.anti_default_rule: FORBIDDEN to use Inter for Headings or Section Titles. Use Cabinet Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans with tight tracking.

layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Dashboards & Analytics)
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #1F293D, crisp edges with subtle inner light bleed on active elements
layout_and_spacing.navigation_style: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-800 z-50 sticky top-0

end_user_views.name: Active ServiceNow Incidents Table
features: Search by Incident ID / Short Description
Filter by Severity (P1-P4), Status (New/In Progress/On Hold), Application
Real-time Refresh button with loading spinner
Analyze Incident action button per row

end_user_views.name: Incident Details Modal & AI Analysis Trigger
features: ServiceNow Incident metadata preview (SYS_ID, State, Assigned Group, Urgency)
Click 'Analyze Incident' triggering mock/live LLM API request with animated streaming progress state

end_user_views.name: AI Analysis Result Panel (5 Sections)
sections: 1. Likely Root Cause (Detailed breakdown with log evidence)
2. Business Impact (Financial risk, impacted user count, SLA breach countdown)
4. Preventive Action (Long-term architecture fix / KB reference)
5. Confidence Badge (High/Medium/Low with score bar & explainability tooltip)

admin_dashboard_views.name: ServiceNow Integration Config
features: Instance URL, Username/Password or OAuth Token, Table Name, Connection Test button with success/failure status diagnostic

admin_dashboard_views.name: AI LLM Configuration
features: Provider selector (OpenAI, Anthropic, Custom LLM), Model ID, API Key input with masking, Temperature slider, Prompt Template editor, Test AI Connection button

admin_dashboard_views.name: Applications CRUD
features: Manage Banking Apps (e.g., Core Banking Gateway, Payment Processing API, Mobile Auth Service), Tier assignment, App Lead, SLA threshold

admin_dashboard_views.name: Knowledge Base CRUD
features: Manage Articles, Incident Tags, Fix Procedures, Searchable KB repository for AI grounding

admin_dashboard_views.name: RCA Repository CRUD
features: Historical Root Cause Analyses, Resolved Incident Patterns, Post-Mortem documents upload/editor

admin_dashboard_views.name: Historical Incidents Viewer
features: Archived ServiceNow tickets, Resolution time metrics, Repeat incident detector

admin_dashboard_views.name: Analysis History Table
features: Log of all AI analyses run, user who triggered, execution time, token usage, feedback rating

admin_dashboard_views.name: Audit Logs Viewer
features: Full security compliance trail (User login, Config updates, Incident actions, Export logs to JSON/CSV)

admin_dashboard_views.name: Integration & Deployment Guide
features: Interactive step-by-step guide with code snippets, ServiceNow Webhook setup, Docker setup, Environment Variable validator

motion_and_interactions.ai_loading_state: Pulse shimmer with blue/cyan glowing border during AI analysis generation
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use sonner library for success/error alerts with distinct high-contrast status icons

media_and_assets.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively (e.g., AlertTriangle, Activity, ShieldCheck, Database, Cpu, Terminal, RefreshCw, Filter, Search, BookOpen, Layers, History, Settings, ExternalLink)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, table rows, form inputs, modals, status badges, and action buttons MUST have a kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='incident-search-input', data-testid='analyze-incident-btn-INC0012948', data-testid='servicenow-test-connection-btn')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA compliant contrast on all badges and interactive states

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines file carefully before starting frontend implementation.
2. Maintain strict separation of End User Incident Workspace and Admin Management Panels via sub-routes or sidebar tabs.

3. Build rich interactive mock data with realistic enterprise banking incidents (e.g. 'INC0091823: Core Payment API 504 Timeout during SWIFT processing', 'INC0091824: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion on Auth Cluster').
4. Ensure Google Auth mock/live state works smoothly with role toggling (End User vs Admin) for easy test verification.
5. Every table must support quick search, column filtering, and pagination.
6. Include a clear 'Test Connection' diagnostic dialog/card for both ServiceNow REST API and AI API in the Admin section.
7. Always attach appropriate data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
